user.title: Bill Tracker
user.description: Create the local bill database and enable the dashboard card.

abort.not_setup: Bill Tracker is not loaded. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.category_not_found: The selected bill type no longer exists.
abort.payer_not_found: The selected payer no longer exists.

error.invalid_category: Check the bill type data. The name, recurrence, default payer or color may be invalid.
error.category_in_use: This bill type has history and cannot be deleted. Disable it instead.
error.invalid_payer: Check payer name and default share. A payer with this name may already exist.
error.payer_in_use: This payer is referenced by bills, bill defaults or settlements. Disable the payer instead.

add_payer.title: Add payer
add_payer.description: The default share is used as a weight when Billy automatically splits a bill between active payers.

edit_payer.title: Edit payer
edit_payer.description: Disabling a payer keeps all history but removes the payer from new automatic splits.

delete_payer.title: Delete {name}
delete_payer.description: Only a payer that has never been referenced can be deleted.

add_category.title: Add bill type
add_category.description: Choose recurrence, default payer and the color used in stacked spending charts.

edit_category.title: Edit bill type
edit_category.description: The default payer is preselected when adding this bill. Disabling the type keeps its history.

delete_category.title: Delete {name}
delete_category.description: Only bill types with no history can be deleted.
